en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 5. Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan ibn Aḥmad ibn Walīd narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan Al-Saffār, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain ibn Abil Khaťťāb, from Safwān ibn Yaḥyā, from Isḥāq ibn ‘Ammār, who said:

I asked Abal Ḥasan (Imam Kāżim (a.s.)), “May I sacrifice myself for you! Can I establish voluntary prayers in the two Ḥarams and next to the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) if I am a Muqassir?” Imam (a.s.) replied, “Yes, as much as you can.”
